blocks.orig: Exceptional natural beauty, a breathtaking view of Lake Duluti and the garden as well as the ambiance of a colonial coffee farm make the Arusha Serena Hotel, Resort & Spa one of the most timeless and peaceful places in Tanzania. Each of the 42 carefully designed guest rooms has been inspired by the heritage and natural splendour and welcomes guests to experience the romance and simplicity of a 1920s lakeside retreat. All accommodations are designed in the style of a stone house and grouped around a village square with beautifully manicured lawns and extensive gardens. The rooms are decorated in warm reds and fresh whites and feature classic country-style design elements such as tile floors and French doors overlooking the garden and lake.
blocks.html: With its exceptional natural beauty, its sweeping views over the garden and Lake Duluti and the feel of a colonial coffee farm, the Arusha Serena Hotel, Resort & Spa ranks among the most peaceful and timeless spots in Tanzania. Inspired by local heritage and the splendour of nature, each of its 42 guest rooms has been designed with care and lets you step into the simple romance of a lakeside retreat from the 1920s. The rooms are styled as stone houses and arranged around a village square, surrounded by well-tended lawns and spacious gardens. Their interiors combine warm red tones with crisp white, together with traditional country-house touches like tiled floors and French doors that open onto views of the lake and garden.

blocks.orig: Would you like to start your morning with an English breakfast at Lake Duluti? Or perhaps end the afternoon with sundowner cocktails and snacks on a safari chair by the water? Or a romantic dinner by the restaurant’s blazing wooden fireplace? It’s all possible at Arusha Serena, where luxury and comfort await.
blocks.html: Fancy starting your day with an English breakfast by Lake Duluti? Or rounding off the afternoon with sundowner cocktails and snacks in a safari chair at the water’s edge? Or enjoying a romantic dinner beside the restaurant’s blazing wood fire? At Arusha Serena you can do it all, with luxury and comfort waiting for you.
